package task

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CreateTaskInput holds fields for task creation.
type CreateTaskInput struct {
	ID                     string
	SourceKey              string
	LessonID               string
	Title                  string
	Description            string
	Translations           []domain.TaskI18n
	LearningTargets        []domain.TaskLearningTarget
	CodeStructureTypeID    string
	CodeStructure          []byte
	ComposeConfig          []byte
	Type                   *string
	AssessmentPurpose      *string
	ExecutionMode          *string
	EvaluationMode         *string
	UIMode                 *string
	SubmissionMode         *string
	RequiresSandbox        *bool
	ExposesPreview         *bool
	ExposesTerminal        *bool
	SupportsLiveValidation *bool
	AllowedErrorsCount     int
	Order                  int
	MaxAttempts            *int
	Tests                  []domain.TaskTest
	StarterFiles           []domain.TaskFileStorage
}

// CreateTask creates a new task.
type CreateTask struct {
	Tasks           repository.TaskRepository
	Lessons         repository.LessonRepository
	TaskI18n        repository.TaskI18nRepository
	TaskTests       repository.TaskTestRepository
	TaskFiles       repository.TaskFileStorageRepository
	LearningTargets repository.TaskLearningTargetRepository
	Publisher       domain.EventPublisher
	StructureRes    repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
	ComposeConfigs  repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	Tx              repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle validates and creates task.
func (uc CreateTask) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateTaskInput) (domain.Task, error) {
	learningTargets, err := domain.NormalizeTaskLearningTargets(in.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Task{}, err
	}
	requestedType, err := requestedTaskTypeCode(in.Type)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Task{}, err
	}
	purpose := domain.AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck
	if in.AssessmentPurpose != nil {
		purpose, err = domain.NormalizeAssessmentPurpose(*in.AssessmentPurpose)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.Task{}, err
		}
	}
	sourceKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(in.SourceKey)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Task{}, err
	}
	in.SourceKey = sourceKey
	isAssessmentTask := domain.IsAssessmentTaskType(requestedType)
	assessmentKind := domain.TaskAssessmentKind(requestedType)
	if purpose == domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic && !isAssessmentTask {
		return domain.Task{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	var structureType *domain.CodeStructureType
	if isAssessmentTask {
		if err := normalizeTaskTestSourceKeys(in.Tests, assessmentKind); err != nil {
			return domain.Task{}, err
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateTaskAssessments(in.Tests, in.AllowedErrorsCount, assessmentKind); err != nil {
			return domain.Task{}, err
		}
		structureType, err = uc.StructureRes.GetByCode(ctx, domain.TaskAssessmentCodeStructureType(requestedType))
		if err != nil {
			return domain.Task{}, err
		}
		in.CodeStructureTypeID = structureType.ID
		in.CodeStructure = domain.DefaultTaskAssessmentCodeStructure(assessmentKind)
		in.ComposeConfig = nil
	} else {
		if strings.TrimSpace(in.CodeStructureTypeID) == "" || len(bytes.TrimSpace(in.CodeStructure)) == 0 {
			return domain.Task{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if len(in.Tests) > 0 {
			return domain.Task{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		in.AllowedErrorsCount = 0
		if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(requestedType, in.CodeStructure); err != nil {
			return domain.Task{}, err
		}
		structureType, err = uc.StructureRes.GetByID(ctx, in.CodeStructureTypeID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.Task{}, err
		}
	}
	var task domain.Task
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		taskID := strings.TrimSpace(in.ID)
		if taskID == "" {
			taskID = uuid.NewString()
		} else if _, err := uuid.Parse(taskID); err != nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		translations := normalizeTranslations(in.Translations)
		if len(translations) == 0 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		title := translations[0].Title
		description := translations[0].Description

		var composeConfigID *string
		in.ComposeConfig = domain.NormalizeComposeConfig(in.ComposeConfig)
		if len(in.ComposeConfig) > 0 && uc.ComposeConfigs != nil {
			existing, err := uc.ComposeConfigs.GetByConfig(ctx, in.ComposeConfig)
			if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
				return err
			}
			if existing != nil {
				composeConfigID = &existing.ID
			} else {
				title, description := domain.DeriveComposeConfigMeta(in.ComposeConfig)
				config := domain.ComposeConfig{
					ID:          uuid.NewString(),
					Title:       &title,
					Description: &description,
					Config:      in.ComposeConfig,
					CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
				}
				if err := uc.ComposeConfigs.Create(ctx, config); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				composeConfigID = &config.ID
			}
		}
		caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities(structureType.Code, in.CodeStructure, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{
			Type:                   in.Type,
			ExecutionMode:          in.ExecutionMode,
			EvaluationMode:         in.EvaluationMode,
			UIMode:                 in.UIMode,
			SubmissionMode:         in.SubmissionMode,
			RequiresSandbox:        in.RequiresSandbox,
			ExposesPreview:         in.ExposesPreview,
			ExposesTerminal:        in.ExposesTerminal,
			SupportsLiveValidation: in.SupportsLiveValidation,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := domain.ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(in.CodeStructure, caps.SupportsLiveValidation); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		task = domain.Task{
			ID:                  taskID,
			SourceKey:           in.SourceKey,
			LessonID:            in.LessonID,
			AssessmentPurpose:   purpose,
			Title:               title,
			Description:         description,
			CodeStructureTypeID: in.CodeStructureTypeID,
			CodeStructure:       in.CodeStructure,
			ComposeConfigID:     composeConfigID,
			ComposeConfig:       in.ComposeConfig,
			Order:               in.Order,
			Status:              domain.TaskStatusActive,
			Version:             1,
			CreatedAt:           time.Now().UTC(),
			UpdatedAt:           time.Now().UTC(),
			MaxAttempts:         in.MaxAttempts,
			AllowedErrorsCount:  in.AllowedErrorsCount,
		}
		domain.ApplyTaskCapabilities(&task, caps)
		if err := validateSandboxRuntime(ctx, uc.Lessons, &task); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := uc.Tasks.Create(ctx, task); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if uc.LearningTargets == nil && len(learningTargets) > 0 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if uc.LearningTargets != nil {
			for index := range learningTargets {
				learningTargets[index].TaskID = task.ID
			}
			if err := uc.LearningTargets.ReplaceForTask(ctx, task.ID, learningTargets); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			task.LearningTargets = learningTargets
		}

		if uc.TaskI18n != nil {
			for _, translation := range translations {
				translation.TaskID = task.ID
				if err := uc.TaskI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		if isAssessmentTask && uc.TaskTests != nil {
			if err := uc.TaskTests.ReplaceForTask(ctx, task.ID, prepareTaskTests(task.ID, in.Tests)); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if uc.TaskFiles != nil {
			starterFiles := normalizeTaskStarterFiles(task.ID, in.StarterFiles)
			if err := uc.TaskFiles.ReplaceForTask(ctx, task.ID, starterFiles); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return domain.Task{}, err
	}
	_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(ctx, domain.SubjectTaskCreated, map[string]any{"task_id": task.ID, "lesson_id": task.LessonID})
	return task, nil
}
